operations.description: Used to obtain an advisory in CVRF format for a given advisory ID `advisory_id` (i.e., cisco-sa-20150819-pcp)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf advisory [PARAMS] advisory id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all advisories in Common Vulnerability Reporting Format (CVRF). For more information about CVRF go to https://communities.cisco.com/docs/DOC-63156 . By default the output is in JSON. To obtain the output in XML use the .xml extension. For example, /advisories/cvrf/all.xml
Used to obtain an advisory in CVRF format for a given Common Vulnerability Enumerator (CVE). The `cve_id` format is CVE-YYYY-NNNN. For more information about CVE visit http://cve.mitre.org/
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf cve [PARAMS] cve id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all the latest security advisories in CVRF format given an absolute number. For instance, the latest 10 or latest 5.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf latest [PARAMS] number [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all the advisories that affects the given product name.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf product [PARAMS] product [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all security advisories for a given security impact rating (critical, high, medium, or low) in CVRF format.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf severity [PARAMS] severity [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all security advisories for a given security impact rating (critical, high, medium, or low) in CVRF format and additionally filter based of firstpublished start date and enddate
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf severity firstpublished [PARAMS] date end severity start [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all security advisories for a given security impact rating (critical, high, medium, or low) in CVRF format.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf severity lastpublished [PARAMS] date end severity start [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all security advisories that have were orginally published in a specific year `YYYY`.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories cvrf year [PARAMS] year [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all advisories that affects the given ios version
Used to obtain all advisories that affects the given ios version
Used to obtain OVAL definitions for a given advisory ID `advisory_id` (i.e., cisco-sa-20150819-pcp)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval advisory [PARAMS] advisory id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language (OVAL) definitions available for Cisco security vulnerabilities. For more information about OVAL go to https://communities.cisco.com/docs/DOC-63158 . By default the output is in JSON. To obtain the output in XML use the .xml extension. For example, /advisories/oval/all.xml
Used to obtain OVAL definitions for a given CVE Identifier. The `cve_id` format is CVE-YYYY-NNNN.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval cve [PARAMS] cve id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all the latest OVAL definitions given an absolute number. For instance, the latest 10 or latest 5.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval latest [PARAMS] number [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all the oval advisories that affects the given product name.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval product [PARAMS] product [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all OVAL definitions for a given security impact rating (critical, high, medium, or low).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval severity [PARAMS] severity [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all security advisories for a given security impact rating (critical, high, medium, or low) in OVAL format.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval severity firstpublished [PARAMS] date end severity start [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Used to obtain all security advisories for a given security impact rating (critical, high, medium, or low) in OVAL format.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] security advisories oval severity lastpublished [PARAMS] date end severity start [SCHEMA]
